main.description: Beta query for raw account- and entity-follow records from any publisher. No authentication is required; duplicates are preserved, and before is an exclusive bound on publisher-declared createdAt. Pages are not a snapshot, so late indexing or concurrent changes may cause records to be missed.

before.description: Exclusive upper bound on publisher-declared createdAt, not indexedAt; omit to start with the newest records.

limit.description: Maximum records per page; defaults to 25.

cursor.description: Opaque next-page cursor; keep before unchanged between pages.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: A datetime, limit, cursor, or query parameter is invalid.

recentFollowView.description: Raw indexed account- or entity-follow record with its publisher DID.

cid.description: CID of this indexed record version.

indexedAt.description: Indexing time, or null if unavailable; ordering uses createdAt.

did.description: DID of the repository that published the follow.

record.description: Unmodified follow record; $type identifies its collection.

follows.description: Raw records ordered by createdAt descending, then URI descending; duplicates are included.

cursor.description: Next-page cursor; omitted when no more records are available.
